note: Compliance tier metadata. Tier is an evidence/permission grade, not a quality grade, and it is read from this file rather than hard-coded in the UI so the rules can change without a launcher release.

tiers.name: Allowlisted
tiers.meaning: Named on the target server's allowlist, or is a vanilla setting the launcher merely surfaces. Changing it alters how the client draws, allocates or collects - never what the game does.

tiers.name: Declare first
tiers.meaning: Legal in the sense that it changes nothing observable by a server, but it is a visible change to what you can see. Show it in your staff message rather than hoping nobody asks.

tiers.name: Unavailable
tiers.meaning: Fails the 'does not alter or automate your gameplay and does not provide any combat advantage' test. Not toggleable in any build. A C tier is a refusal, not a default-off.

categories.name: Performance
categories.blurb: Frame-time work. All of it is on the server allowlist and none of it touches a packet.

categories.name: HUD
categories.blurb: Read-outs and overlays. Draw budget only.

categories.name: Visual
categories.blurb: How the world is drawn. Every one of these is a visibility trade, not a free win.

categories.name: Quality of life
categories.blurb: Things that remove friction without adding information.

categories.name: Coaching
categories.blurb: Measurement and drill feedback. Local only, never uploaded.

categories.name: Media
categories.blurb: Recording and staging tools for your own clips and stills.
